stock.description: Herbs Generation Group Holdings Ltd. specializes in the formulation, distribution, and promotion of health supplements, cosmetic items, and skincare solutions. Its extensive portfolio encompasses brands like Herbs, ZINO, Classic, Umeya, Energie, Regal Green, Men’s Infinity, and Herbs Pet. The firm commenced operations on March 22, 2024, with its principal office situated in Hong Kong.
